notes: Source: 2026 New Orleans Saints Media Guide (IA item new-orleans-saints-2026-media-guide-2026-08-13, 568 pdf pages, info current as of July 20, 2026). PDF page = printed page + 2 (e.g. printed 345 'Career Leaders' is pdf p347; printed 361 is pdf p363); every pdf_page here is the PDF page. Career Leaders pdf pp. 347-350, Individual Records pdf pp. 363-372. Every digit was read from 200 dpi crops of the page pictures.

Regular season: the Career Leaders and Individual Records sections carry no postseason numbers (the guide has separate 'Individual Playoff Records', pdf pp. 388-390, not used); the career totals match across sections (Brees 68,010 passing yards, Kamara 7,250 rushing yards, Colston 9,759 receiving yards).

through_season 2025: the Individual Records pages carry 2025 games (Rashid Shaheed 10/5/25, Justin Reid 11/23/25, Charlie Smyth 12/21/25), active-player careers are printed open-ended ('2017-', '2011-'), and the Yearly Leaders run through 2025 (Cameron Jordan, 10.5 sacks).

Career lists use the Career Leaders tables (top 10, with printed rank numbers and extra columns, all kept in raw) wherever a table ranked by exactly that stat exists (passing yards, passing TDs, rushing yards, receptions, receiving yards, sacks, interceptions). There is no Career Leaders table ranked by rushing TDs or receiving TDs, so those two career lists come from Individual Records (3 and 4 rows printed); the TD columns of the Career Leaders tables agree with them. Season and game lists come from Individual Records (the guide prints 3 to 5 rows, and no rank numbers: ranks follow printed order, tied values share the lowest rank, tie=true marks tied rows; in raw a parenthesised number such as '(13)' is the value printed on an earlier line of the same tie group).

Printed rank numbers with typos in Career Leaders: rushing yards prints 'Mark Ingram II' and 'Deuce McAllister' both as '2.' (values 6,500 vs 6,096); receiving yards prints 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10 (Kamara and Abramowicz both '5.', Graham '6.', no '7.'); interceptions prints '8.' once for a four-way tie at 15. The rank field here is the true position in the printed order (ties by equal value), raw keeps the printed rank text.

Open-ended careers printed '(2017-)' / '2011-' (Alvin Kamara, Cameron Jordan: still active in 2026) are written years='2017-present' / '2011-present' so the span can be read as through 2025; raw keeps the printed form.

Game lists: Individual Records print the dates as M/D/YY ('9/4/83'); years holds MM/DD/YYYY (two-digit year widened, 67-99 -> 19xx, 00-26 -> 20xx; all games are 1967 or later) plus the printed opponent text, raw keeps the printed form. January dates (e.g. 1/2/22) are the printed calendar dates of games in the season that began the previous fall.
The guide prints 'Opponent' sub-lists inside each category (records by the other team's players); they were not used. Bold rows on the printed pages mark active players.

Game TD passes: the 5-TD line reads '9 times, last Jameis Winston vs. Green Bay, 9/12/21' (aggregate); only that most-recent game is copied, flagged tie=true, the other eight 5-TD games are not named in the guide.

Years differences inside the guide: Danny Abramowicz is '1967-73' in Career Leaders and '1967-72' in Individual Records; Will Smith is '2004-12' in Career Leaders and '2004-13' in Individual Records; Michael Thomas is '2016-20, 2022-23' in Career Leaders and '2016-' in the Individual Records receptions list. Each list keeps the years of the section it was copied from.
Tackles: no regular-season tackles record list exists in this guide, so those three pairs are 'missing'.
